name: 비디오 스펙트럼 코히어런스 분석
description: Measures spectral coherence between consecutive frames — AI-generated videos show distinct spectral jumps.
mechanism:
This method analyzes spectral coherence across video frame regions for deepfake detection:

1. **Regional스펙트럼분석**: The spatial frequency spectrum is computed independently for multiple regions: face, background, clothing, hair. Each region's spectral characteristic — spectral slope, cutoff frequency, spectral peaks — is measured.

2. **Cross-영역스펙트럼일관성**: All regions captured through the same optical system should show coherent spectral characteristics — same noise spectrum, same spectral cutoff (determined by the lens MTF), same compression artifacts. The method checks cross-region spectral coherence. Deepfake composites show spectral incoherence between generated face and captured background.

3. **스펙트럼노이즈Floor매칭**: The spectral noise floor (high-frequency baseline noise level) should be uniform across the frame. The method compares noise floors between regions — different noise floors indicate content from different imaging/generation pipelines.

4. **스펙트럼Transition분석**: At region boundaries (face-background border), the spectral transition should be smooth. The method analyzes spectral characteristics across boundaries — abrupt spectral changes at the face border (changing noise spectrum, changing spectral slope) indicate compositing.

5. **시간적스펙트럼일관성**: The spectral relationship between regions should remain stable over time. The method tracks inter-region spectral ratios — temporal variation in the face-to-background spectral ratio indicates the face content varies independently from the background, consistent with deepfake generation.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
